content:
Enables or disables the link state of the scanner identified by scanner_id .
Requires the Scan Manager [40] user role. See Roles.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
PATH PARAMETERS
Content type
Content type
integer <int32>
The ID of the scanner.
REQUEST BODY SCHEMA:
application/json
integer <int32>
Pass 1  enable the link. Pass 0  to disable.
